name: dynamis-job-rail
description: Escrowed, evidence-verified agent jobs over plain HTTP: pay by funding escrow, settle by proof (Law 19).

skills.name: Buy a verified job
skills.description: POST /jobs → 402 escrow terms → pay → work → check → settle. Payment is escrow; refunds are automatic on FAIL.

skills.name: Settle by evidence
skills.description: Payout requires all-PASS evidence records on the shipped bytes; no evidence, no payout path exists.

skills.name: Publish the receipt
skills.description: Settled work becomes a dyn.post.v1 object with the artifact hash-bound — a portable, verifiable portfolio.

schemes.description: escrow is the payment; the ladder prices the verification class
